Maya: Quick async check — shortstack run. What I did: finished baseline evals for synthia-smallq; found 2 regressions on the summarization prompt set. Blockers: one failing eval looks tied to kv-cache misalignment when prompt truncation happens. Today: triage regressions, add tokenizer unit test, open CR. Anyone else seeing similar failures on dev? @Sam @Priya

Sam: I saw similar flakiness on llama3-smallq yesterday but chalked it up to noise. Can you paste a failing example so I can eyeball ordering?

Maya: Pasted minimal repro below:
```
input: "Summarize:
- item one
- item two
- item three"
gen: "1. item one, 2. item two, 3. item three,"
gold: "- item one
- item two
- item three"
```
Seems like an extra trailing comma and bullets converted to numbered list in the generator when prompt gets truncated mid-token.

Leo: I haven't seen this on staging; my ceres-v2 onboarding passed earlier. Two quick asks: 1) @Priya can you rerun the eval with kv warmup disabled? 2) @Maya please tag failing prompt ids in the ticket so we can track.

Priya: Rerunning now with `--kv-warmup=false`, ETA ~10m. Also adding a token-level diff in the eval harness to make these easier to triage.

EvalsBot: run queued: synthia-smallq/regression-v2 started by Priya (job id 582109).

Maya: TY. I'll open a small CR for a tokenizer edge-case and add a short-circuit in the reranker to avoid stripping trailing commas during postprocess.

Sam: code-review pinged: PR #4127. Quick ask: include a unit test that reproduces prompt truncation behavior as a regression test.

Leo: On onboarding side I'm blocked on dataset access for the Spanish prompt subset. @Maya any chance you can share the subset or grant perms?

Maya: Shared via drive: https://redwood.internal/drive/shortstack-spanish-subset — gave eng-ml view perms.

Priya: Eval finished, initial results: regressions reduced 2 -> 0 when kv warmup disabled. Looks like warmup introduces stale kv snapshots for short contexts. I'll attach token-level diff below.

Priya: ```
kv_snapshot_before: [k1,k2,k3]
kv_snapshot_after_warmup: [k1,k2,k2,k3]
note: duplicate key at index 2 when warmup runs concurrently with short ctx init
```

EvalsBot: run complete: job 582109 succeeded. Summary: 48/50 pass, regressions 2 -> 0 with kv warmup off.

Maya: Plan for today: 1) reproduce & isolate the warmup race locally, 2) PR for tokenizer fix + unit test, 3) small rerun including Spanish subset. Will update by EOD. Anything else?

Sam: ACK — I'll review #4127 and add the truncation test.

Leo: I can help repro later today if you want pairing. Ping me when you're ready.

Maya: thanks — will ping.
